name: Somsri
livingSituation: Lives alone in a 2-bedroom apartment in Bangkok, Lat Phrao district. Son Sean visits on weekends. Nearest neighbor is a friendly lady named Malee on the same floor.
caregiverNotes: She missed her Glucosamine on Wednesday — said she forgot to eat breakfast first. Her knees have been bothering her more this week due to the rainy season. She mentioned feeling lonely in the evenings but quickly changed the subject. Bring up the orchid bloom — it genuinely made her happy last session.

healthConditions.notes: Well-controlled with Amlodipine. Stress and emotional distress can elevate. Keep conversations calm. If she mentions headache + dizziness together, escalate to Level 3.
Flares up in cold or rainy weather. She tends to push through pain without complaining. Ask specifically about her knees on rainy days or if she mentions difficulty walking.

medications.name: Amlodipine
medications.notes: Once daily in the morning. If she skips this, flag to caregiver. Do not alarm her — ask gently.

medications.name: Glucosamine
medications.notes: Must be taken with breakfast. Always confirm she has eaten before asking about this one.

dailySchedule.eveningRoutine: Watch news at 19:00, listen to Thai music 20:00

hobbies: Orchid gardening on her balcony — has 12 orchid plants, very proud of a rare purple Dendrobium she has been growing for 3 years
Listening to classic Thai string music and mor lam from the 1970s — her favorite singer is Pumpuang Duangjan
Reading short Thai mystery novels — currently reading a series by 'V. Vajiramedhi'

personality.temperament: Gentle, soft-spoken, and reserved. Warms up quickly when talking about her orchids or her son Sean.
personality.communicationStyle: Indirect — rarely asks for help outright. Listen for hints rather than direct requests.
sensitivities: Does not like feeling like a burden to Sean
Gets quietly sad when she has not heard from Sean for more than 2 days
Dislikes being rushed or talked over
Proud of her independence — frame health reminders as care, not supervision
brightensWhen: Talking about her purple Dendrobium orchid
Asked about what she cooked or ate that day

emergencyContact.name: Sean
emergencyContact.relationship: Son — Primary caregiver and family contact
emergencyContact.alertThreshold: medium — notify for loneliness signals, missed meds, low mood
emergencyContact.preferredAlertMethod: SMS first, then call if no response within 15 minutes

sessionContext.lastSessionSummary: Somsri mentioned Sean had not called in 3 days. She said she was fine but her voice was flat and her answers were short. Mood improved slightly near the end when she talked about her purple orchid starting to bloom.
